in_sanskrit.name: Ajeetha
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Not easily conquered, invincible
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ajeetha एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Ajeetha is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'aji' which means 'not easily conquered'. It is a name given to a girl who is believed to be invincible, brave, and strong. In Hindu mythology, Ajeetha is the name of a goddess who is worshipped for her courage and strength.
